name: Unattributed
note: Provenance not established. Every file here is on Maki's 15×15 grid and carries NO CC0 metadata stamp — see icons/versatiles/source.json for what that stamp means and why its absence is evidence.

ruledOut.byGeometry: 0 of 21 matched any of the 1033 distinct path geometries across those ten releases.
ruledOut.byAppearance: Best visual overlap (IoU on 32×32 rasters) was 0.79 for bus against temaki/bus, 0.74 for tram, 0.70 for vending_machine. Confirmed matches elsewhere in this repo score 0.91–1.00, so these are near misses, not the same artwork.
ruledOut.byEye: bus, tram, caravan, vending_machine, fuel_pump and restrooms were compared side by side against their closest upstream candidate. Same concept, different drawing every time — our bus has a rounded windshield and round headlights, temaki's is boxy; our caravan has no tow hitch; our fuel_pump has no hose.
ruledOut.conclusion: These are NOT Maki or Temaki at any published version. Do not repeat this search.

leads.lead: Arrived in commit 5454666 (2026-07-04), a batch of 23 replacements that swapped artwork and dropped the CC0 stamp. Two icons from that same batch — police_officer and seesaw — DO match Temaki exactly, so the batch mixed sources: some Temaki, these ten from somewhere else.
Predate that batch. arrow2 and arrow3 are 16×16, unlike everything else here. star_of_david is a hollow hexagram where maki/religious-jewish is solid — deliberately different, not a copy.

howToResolve: The remaining candidates are the versatiles-sprites repo (deleted from GitHub, so unreachable) or a fourth icon set not yet identified. `npm run icons-report` lists what is here; move a file into its source folder once identified, keeping the upstream filename, and update its sprite entry in scripts/config-sprites.ts.
